newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Servgro says to list Forbes on JSE.
newsitem.headline: Servgro says to list Forbes on JSE.

text.p: Servgro International Ltd and Forbes Financial Services Group Holdings said on Monday that they would proceed with the listing of Forbes on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange by initially issuing ordinary shares worth 62.25 million rand to selected institutions and staff.
Following this issue Forbes will undertake a renounceable rights offer to existing shareholders to raise 40 million rand.
Servgro said it had undertaken to renounce the majority of its entitlement in favour of its shareholders.

The companies said the purpose of listing Forbes was to establish it as an independent business with its own profile and objectives, to raise additional capital for expansion of the business in the short-term both locally and internationally and to facilitate its future long-term expansion.
This announcement follows an earlier announcement on August 23. A further announcment will be made in the second half of this month.
